codeConventions: Use type hints on all functions (mypy strict mode)
Add docstrings to all public functions
testingGuidelines: Run full test suite: poetry run pytest -v
Use fixtures from conftest.py for DuckDB connections
Mock Dagster context in asset tests
Integration tests use isolated test databases
Always test with sample data in data/sample_data/
beforeCommit: Ensure all checks pass before committing

importantPatterns.data_contract: Create YAML in data/contracts/ before ingesting new sources
importantPatterns.schemas: prod_meta, prod_raw, prod_stg, prod_core, prod_mart, prod_imart, seed
importantPatterns.idempotency: MD5 hashing in prod_meta.ingest_ledger prevents duplicate ingestion

dockerCommands.restart: docker compose down && docker compose up --build -d

dbtCommands.run_all: cd transform/dbt && poetry run dbt run
dbtCommands.run_model: cd transform/dbt && poetry run dbt run --select {model_name}
dbtCommands.run_downstream: cd transform/dbt && poetry run dbt run --select {model_name}+
dbtCommands.test: cd transform/dbt && poetry run dbt test

environmentNotes: All paths in .env use forward slashes (even on Windows)
Pipeline runs entirely locally in Docker
